Episode 212. Return Command (1)
Gliek, Kial, S, Nirgand, Morganiel.
The Black Sea's five kings.
The expedition of Siron was finally engaged in battle with 'S', following Kial. It had been almost four years since their last encounter with a king of the Black Sea, Kial.
The reason there had not been a single death in the expedition so far was solely because of the existence of a man named Siron Runkandel.
And this time, Siron had no intention of letting his daughter and knights die. And Ozdok, the legendary monster who had formally become a member of the Runkandel.
"Vanessa, you start pulling out and take care of Ozdok. From now on, he won't be able to withstand the aftermath."
It had already been two days since the battle with S began.
As soon as Ozdok faced S, he had left the battlefield and moved far to the rear, but Siron was expecting the impact of the battle to reach there now.
"Understood, Lord."
"Luna, can you hold on a bit longer?"
"I'm still fine, Father."
"You've grown."
"Because I've endured the worst area on the surface."
Even though they were in a life-or-death battle with S.

The atmosphere of Siron's expedition was quite different from before. The eyes of the knights, who were dying from exposure to chaos, were full of vitality and aggression as they were before they entered the Black Sea, and from Siron, the passion of 'enjoying' the fight was oozing.
In other words, it was not as dark and miserable as before.
The atmosphere was completely different from when they thought their given future was nothing more than to explore the Black Sea and die or become monsters.
All of this was due to Siron's awakening. Siron had been free from the magic power just before the fight with S began.
As Vanessa withdrew from the battlefield, Luna and the Black Knights reformed their ranks behind Siron.
[Siron... How can you be so fine? After killing my brother, Kial, you should have definitely been tormented by the magic power.]
S couldn't understand.

The five kings of the Black Sea had all been sure that Siron would eventually become the same as them. They said that Siron would unleash the will of the gods who brought down the Black Sea's five kings and that the kings of the Black Sea would finally be reborn as complete beings.
The power he possessed was something that humans should never have.
"I suffered for a long time. There were countless moments when I almost became like you."

[You overcame all those moments... What on earth could have made you do so? The will to transcend fate is like a consumable. It's impossible for both immortals and mortals to transcend permanently. You should have already used up all the will you had...]
"Permanent transcendence, I'm not sure about that. My lifespan isn't infinite, so when it ends, my will may also sleep. But, you won't be around to see it."
S, you will be annihilated here today.
Siron concluded, laughing gently. In his confident and dignified figure, there were no traces of lingering spirits to be found.
"The only thing that can stop me is death. But there is no one left in the world who can kill me."
"Siron, you…!"
S could only be furious.
Because facing Siron, he couldn't not believe his words. He had no choice but to admit the arrogance of saying he was now invincible to anything that could kill him.
S watched.
The sword aimed at him by the first mortal who had overcome the magic power. Just looking at it gave him a sense of being torn and cut, tormenting his inner self.
Even when Kial was killed.
The kings of the Black Sea judged that Siron had taken a step further to unite them. The annihilation of Kial was painful, but Siron had merely absorbed all the chaos he had.
Eventually, Siron, carrying all of Kial's chaos, would become the same as them, they said.
'How on earth... my brothers, now Siron Runkandel is... not the being to make us one again, but the one to destroy us...!'
S was accepting the fact that it was a misjudgment.
Siron was not a divided, incomplete being like them from the start, but a monster standing tall on its own.
The moment Barisada moved, S released a tremendous amount of spirit to block Siron's approach. S was in the form of a dog with one eye, and his huge body was quickly hidden in the spirit.
The Black Knights of all generations and Luna could not track S's movement. As it's impossible to know the location of a whale, no matter how big, when it swims in the deep sea.
However, Siron quickly wiped out the spirits that had covered him, Luna, and the knights, and located the space where S was trying to hide.
"I said you will be annihilated in this place today."
Siron's will became words, and those words became an inevitable sentence. Barisada was precisely piercing the center of S's eye.
The eye healed immediately, but S shuddered at the fact that nearly 10% of the spirit that formed him had already disappeared.

No matter how transcendent the power of Changsung is, it cannot annihilate the spirits of the Black Sea's five kings at such a fast speed. As far as S knew, there were only three who could do such a thing.
The witch Helrum, the god who created the gods.
And their biggest piece, Morganiel.
"Changsung... Are you saying there is a realm beyond it?"
"My sword is the same as before. Only that the demonic power is gone, I can swing it with a clear mind."
With a thud!
S's neck fell to the ground. Luna and the Black Knights of past generations assisted Siron by cutting off the spirit trying to reconnect the neck and the body.
Siron was still the only one who could inflict essential and fatal damage to the kings of the Black Sea among the expedition.
However, Luna's Red Moon also had the potential to exert a power similar to that of Changsung.
"Save your red sword aura, Luna. Until you reach the same state as me, the number of times you can use that sword is limited."
Luna understood Siron's words as a caution to conserve for future encounters with other Black Sea Kings. The situation did not warrant her overusing the Red Moon to assist her father.
"Understood, Father."
Every time Siron swung his sword, S's spirit, the dark area he was forming, was being cut away like paper.
Had he not sent Vanessa ahead, Ozdok would not have been able to withstand the aftermath and would have died.
Even as Siron began to conclude his battle with S, he thought of Ozdok's foolish appearance and smiled gently. By now, the guy would have been clinging to Vanessa, crying, "Oh, my dear."
'The youngest sent a treasure... Ozdok. If he hadn't possessed his unique frivolity and inferior personality, I would have lost all of my humanity before meeting S.'
The battle continued like this.
S merely resisted in vain, while Siron slowly but surely and unilaterally oppressed S.
From time to time, Siron's body received large and small injuries.
But, unlike the time with Kial, no spirits infiltrated his wounds like poison. His skin was torn, and red blood flowed. It was no different from a common being hurt by a common weapon.
Even then, there were no deep wounds that would break bones or damage muscles and organs.

Literally, Siron was overwhelming S. Luna and the Black Knights of past generations only had a few bruises at most. This was because S was so cornered that he couldn't even pay attention to anyone other than Siron.
With a thud!
Soon, Siron stabbed Barisada into Kial's eye once more. The once gigantic S was now of a similar stature to Siron. More than 90% of the spirit that made up S had been annihilated by Barisada.
"How, how... How can this be? What allowed you to overcome your demonic power, Siron...?"
At these words, Siron paused for a moment in thought.
"If I had to choose one."
["...Choose? Do you mean to tell me that you don't even know why?"]
As S said, Siron didn't precisely know why his demonic power had suddenly disappeared. He could only vaguely guess a few possibilities.
"Perhaps I wanted to see the grown-up figure of my youngest in person. I'm also somewhat curious about my other children to whom I could not show much affection. How the clan is doing now."
["This is insane... How could such trivial matters be the reason for your current state? Just those things?"]
"Hahaha, if not, it must be something else."
["SIROOOON!"]
With the last cry filled with resentment, S's voice was no longer heard. Siron looked down at S, who was disintegrating into particles and disappearing, and clicked his tongue.
"It was a weaker fragment than Kial. Now, only Nirgand and Morganiel remain. Good job, everyone."
Luna and the Black Knights of past generations bowed their heads. Siron took a moment to appreciate the landscape of the Black Sea, which had become a little brighter than before, as soon as S died.
Then, as if something exciting happened, he revealed his teeth with a grin and looked back. It was where Vanessa and Ozdok were.
"Father?"
"Hmm... It seems that the potential and fighting spirit I anticipated in my youth have finally come to fruition. The one who had been wandering the wasteland of the sword for a long time."
"Lord, I don't understand what you're saying."
"A welcome visitor has come to find me."
For a while, Luna and the Black Knights of past generations could not understand what he meant. Who on earth could find this place, the deepest and most terrifying land in the world?
A welcome visitor.
Of course, that didn't mean Vanessa and Ozdok. Siron was just feeling the energy of a Rune Kendel, who had just met Vanessa and Ozdok.
"Could it be... The youngest has arrived!?"
Siron did not answer but kept his gaze. Luna and the Black Knights of past generations quietly observed the direction Siron was looking at.
The welcome visitor Siron spoke of was now rushing towards Siron like crazy.
Siron did not move closer or call his name out of consideration for the weary him. It would be an act that would undermine his struggle to get here alone.

Finally, he who had walked to Siron on wobbly legs knelt down on one knee. Luna and the Black Knights of past generations had been unable to close their mouths in surprise from the moment he came into sight.
"Huff, huff... I pay my respects... to the Lord."
Siron bent over and personally helped him up, then replied.
"You've had a tough journey to get here, Zed. Finally, you've moved me at least once."
